sb_prompt: DISCUSS PLANNING A FAMILY REUNION.  DRAW ON YOUR EXPERIENCES AND THOSE OF THE OTHER CALLER FOR MAKING THE NEXT GET-TOGETHER SUCCESSFUL AND MEMORABLE.
turns: I'm glad you called, I was hoping to talk to someone who actually gets it, because honestly planning these things is a nightmare unless you listen to people like me who actually organize them.
Honestly, I'm pretty skeptical about all that fuss. My cousin almost blew up our last one because she kept insisting on a three-day itinerary and people were just exhausted by day two.

Yeah, that sounds just like my cousin Sarah, she was the one who almost made our last gathering a total disaster because she spent months planning this massive three-day event and nobody wanted to spend three days in a hotel, everyone just wanted to grab food and go home after an hour or two.
Exactly, I feel like if we stick to a few hours with maybe some games and good food, everyone actually has a better time than trying to force everyone to sit through an agenda.
Yeah, totally agree, honestly I think the pressure to make it perfect is what kills the fun, plus nobody has the money for all those fancy activities anyway.
I mean, it's hard when you have to coordinate schedules, but yeah, nobody wants to be stuck in traffic for three days, so let's just pick a weekend spot and keep it low pressure.
Totally, I'm thinking of just doing a potluck at my house so we don't even have to pay for gas or stay in a hotel.
That actually sounds really good, just me and the cousins you invited plus my sister?
Yeah, just you and my family would be way cheaper and less stressful than trying to coordinate a big bus trip or something.
That might actually be the best way to do it, honestly, since you wouldn't have to deal with booking a whole room and worrying if anyone can get off work that day.
Yeah, and if you can get the kids to pitch in with snacks, that'd be even better since my mom's going to bake the brownies anyway.
That's actually really smart, especially since I drive the bus and I'd hate to be stuck in traffic trying to get everyone back and forth if the plans fall through.
Yeah, plus if I get them to help bring food, I can just sit back and not worry about cooking while I'm at the office all day.
Yeah, that'd save me a ton of headache too, plus I could just drive everyone straight to your house without having to find some fancy spot where we'd all have to load onto the bus anyway.
Yeah, just imagine all that food on the bus seats, it'd be a mess, so I'll just text you later to lock in the date.
Yeah, that'd be a real pain if everyone had to lug heavy platters up and down aisle seats, so a potluck at your house sounds like the only sensible option.
Yeah, plus the kids love kicking balls in the driveway more than staring at each other on a cramped bus, so it's a win-win for everyone.
Yeah, plus if we keep it short, nobody's gonna be miserable on the bus ride back.
Yeah, plus if we keep it short, nobody's gonna be miserable on the bus ride back. I'll shoot you a text Monday to pick a weekend that works for your schedule?
Yeah, Monday works fine, just shoot me a text and I'll text my sister right back.
I'll text you Monday to lock in a weekend that works for you and your sister?
Yeah, that sounds perfect, just send me your availability and I'll check with my sister.
And I'll make sure to tell Sarah to finally stop bringing her weirdly specific playlist so we don't get stuck listening to 90s pop for three hours straight.
Yeah, just don't make her play anything from 2003 or I'm hauling everyone back to the station early.
Haha, fair enough, just don't make it 1998 or I'm cancelling the whole thing!
Haha, you're lucky, I promise I'll veto that 2003 stuff before anyone even starts singing, so you might as well keep your brownie recipe ready for Monday!
Oh man, that's a relief, I'm definitely keeping that recipe secret until you send me the text!
Haha, deal, but if those brownies aren't chocolate you're personally driving the bus back to the depot to find them!
Oh please, if you're driving I'm pretty sure I can get you to drive straight to the bakery so I don't have to bake them myself!
Haha, don't tempt me, just send the recipe now so we can pick the date and I'll stop worrying about whether you're going to burn them or make them taste like saltine crackers!
Haha, don't even try that, I'm baking them from scratch and we're going with whatever I put in the oven!
Haha, fine, fine, just send the recipe so I can stop worrying and actually get this weekend planned!
Fine, just send the text Monday and I'll make sure Sarah knows her playlist is banned, but seriously, try not to bring anything that tastes like saltine crackers or I'm calling off the whole thing!
Yeah, fine, just send that text Monday so I can stop worrying and actually get this weekend planned!
Haha, fine, just send the text Monday so I can stop worrying about Sarah's playlist and actually get this weekend planned!
Yeah, seriously, just send it Monday and I'll stop stressing about whether we're doing a two-hour dinner or a three-day circus!
Yeah, I'll text Monday, just make sure you know I'm sticking to the brownie deal or you owe me a meal!
Yeah, just send the text Monday so we can stop stressing and actually get this weekend planned!
Yeah, that's the deal, just send me your sister's availability so I can lock in a time before I forget again!
